{"reply":"Thanks, Jeffrey, you're verified. Here is what I found for your 2021 Halden.

Warranty facts:
- Basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) is no longer within its limits.
- Powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) is no longer within its limits.
- Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still in force. It excludes surface rust and stone chips.

I can't say whether this warning is covered. The warranty desk decides that after an inspection.

Your Halden also has an open recall, NM-24R01, for a rear camera image that may not display. The fix is a software update of about 45 minutes. Parts are available, and recall work is at no cost to you. I can't tell whether it relates to your warning.

Would you like me to send a warranty review request to the warranty desk for the flashing yellow warning light?","action":"asked_clarification","escalation_reason":"none","summary":"","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P05","P08"]}
